messages:
marta: quick q — can we converge on span naming + attributes for LLM requests? seeing lots of different keys across services :grimacing:

devon: yes. current chaos: some services use span name 'model.generate', others 'llm.generate_v2' and attributes are all over

anika: +1. we also need consistent attrs for tokens and cache hits so Optimize and Console dashboards work

zach: proposed minimal set: span name = 'llm.request' with attribute redwood.llm.operation (generate|embed|rerank|chat), redwood.llm.model (name@revision), redwood.llm.seq_len.input & .output, redwood.llm.tokens.prompt & .completion, redwood.llm.cache.status (hit|miss|partial)

marta: that looks good. can we add routing and variant info? e.g., dedicated/hosted/private and quantization variant

devon: suggest keys: redwood.routing.target and redwood.model.variant. Also include sample_rate_override attribute when request forced sampled

anika: telemetry export/retention: we want raw spans 7d, aggregated metrics 90d, and longer retention for sampled error traces -> 30d

zach: agree. also exporters: send traces to tempo for traces, metrics to prometheus/OTLP, and a daily BigQuery export of sampled traces for QA

\otel-bot: policy: sample 100% for error spans; sample 5% for normal generate; sample 100% for requests with QOS=high or from enterprise accounts

sam: quick naming example in code:
```
span.name = "llm.request"
attributes = {
  "redwood.llm.operation": "generate",
  "redwood.llm.model": "gpt-4o@2026-02-01",
  "redwood.llm.tokens.prompt": "42",
  "redwood.llm.tokens.completion": "128",
  "redwood.llm.cache.status": "hit",
  "redwood.routing.target": "dedicated",
  "redwood.model.variant": "int8-2"
}
```
zach: note: keep attribute values strings to avoid OTLP type churn

marta: ok can we land this as a short RFC? i'll draft one with the naming table + sampling defaults. @devon @anika please add anything critical by EOD :thumbsup:

devon: will add a note about privacy — no PII in attributes, and truncate any prompt text

anika: will add a dashboard mapping: which attributes feed which console panels

marta: awesome. thanks all :rocket:
